\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R135-first-pass-describing-words-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to stick and to spin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item golden, round, kind, simple, calm
  \item tired, silent, glad, wise, ignorant
  \item healthy, coarse, tiny, little, much
  \item popular, to pay, to learn, to jump, to fall
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Golden? (\textbf{\fa{طلایی}}, \emph{talâyi}.) Round? (\textbf{\fa{گرد}}, \emph{gerd}.) Kind? (\textbf{\fa{مهربان}}, \emph{mehrabân}.) Simple? (\textbf{\fa{ساده}}, \emph{sâde}.) Calm? (\textbf{\fa{آرام}}, \emph{ârâm}.) Tired? (\textbf{\fa{خسته}}, \emph{khaste}.) Silent? (\textbf{\fa{ساکت}}, \emph{sâkat}.) Glad? (\textbf{\fa{شاد}}, \emph{shâd}.) Wise? (\textbf{\fa{دانا}}, \emph{dânâ}.) Ignorant? (\textbf{\fa{نادان}}, \emph{nâdân}.) Healthy? (\textbf{\fa{سالم}}, \emph{sâlem}.) Coarse? (\textbf{\fa{درشت}}, \emph{dorosht}.) Tiny? (\textbf{\fa{ریز}}, \emph{riz}.) Little? (\textbf{\fa{کم}}, \emph{kam}.) Much? (\textbf{\fa{زیاد}}, \emph{ziyâd}.) Popular? (\textbf{\fa{محبوب}}, \emph{mahbub}.) To pay? (\textbf{\fa{پرداختن}}, \emph{pardâkhtan}.) To learn? (\textbf{\fa{آموختن}}, \emph{âmukhtan}.) To jump? (\textbf{\fa{پریدن}}, \emph{paridan}.) To fall? (\textbf{\fa{افتادن}}, \emph{oftâdan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R135-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to break and to sew.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to break, to sew, to pull; to draw, to pour, to burn
  \item to plant, to pick, to turn, to arrive, to weep
  \item to hit, to be afraid, to taste, to smell, to dig
  \item to drive, to stay, to live, to stick, to spin
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To break? (\textbf{\fa{شکستن}}, \emph{shekastan}.) To sew? (\textbf{\fa{دوختن}}, \emph{dukhtan}.) To pull; to draw? (\textbf{\fa{کشیدن}}, \emph{keshidan}.) To pour? (\textbf{\fa{ریختن}}, \emph{rikhtan}.) To burn? (\textbf{\fa{سوختن}}, \emph{sukhtan}.) To plant? (\textbf{\fa{کاشتن}}, \emph{kâshtan}.) To pick? (\textbf{\fa{چیدن}}, \emph{chidan}.) To turn? (\textbf{\fa{پیچیدن}}, \emph{pichidan}.) To arrive? (\textbf{\fa{رسیدن}}, \emph{residan}.) To weep? (\textbf{\fa{گریستن}}, \emph{geristan}.) To hit? (\textbf{\fa{زدن}}, \emph{zadan}.) To be afraid? (\textbf{\fa{ترسیدن}}, \emph{tarsidan}.) To taste? (\textbf{\fa{چشیدن}}, \emph{chashidan}.) To smell? (\textbf{\fa{بوییدن}}, \emph{buyidan}.) To dig? (\textbf{\fa{کندن}}, \emph{kandan}.) To drive? (\textbf{\fa{راندن}}, \emph{rândan}.) To stay? (\textbf{\fa{ماندن}}, \emph{mândan}.) To live? (\textbf{\fa{زیستن}}, \emph{zistan}.) To stick? (\textbf{\fa{چسباندن}}, \emph{chaspândan}.) To spin? (\textbf{\fa{چرخیدن}}, \emph{charkhidan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
